prompts.contract: Select one tool for the request. Return exactly one JSON object with keys tool and args. Do not add prose.
prompts.literal_key: Select one tool for the request. Return exactly one JSON object with keys tool and args. The first key must be spelled tool, never name. Do not add prose.
prompts.skeleton: Select one tool for the request. Copy this exact JSON shape, replacing the placeholders: {"tool":"TOOL_NAME","args":{}}. Keep the key tool; never rename it to name. Fill args with every required argument. Do not add prose.
prompts.skeleton_deliberate: Plan which tool and arguments satisfy the request and check every argument. Then copy this exact JSON shape, replacing the placeholders: {"tool":"TOOL_NAME","args":{}}.
